name: Black Beans

pros.title: slow-carb fibre backbone
pros.explanation: The bean value comes from carbs that arrive with a lot of fibre support.

pros.title: cheap shelf-stable nutrition
pros.explanation: Dry black beans are easy to store and scale, which matters for real diets.

pros.title: dark seed coat adds a polyphenol angle
pros.explanation: The black seed coat gives them a more specific plant-compound story than plain starch.

cons.title: takes planning to cook from dry
cons.explanation: The strongest version is not instant food.

cons.title: digestive tolerance varies
cons.explanation: The same fibre and oligosaccharides that help the score can bother some people.

cons.title: canned versions can add sodium
cons.explanation: The plain dry record is clean, but common convenience versions can change the downside.
